v: This one made even the theatre AC feel suspicious 😅 Uncomfortable subject, hard-hitting scenes, Samantha solid and Mani Sharma BGM keeps you uneasy throughout. Sensitive hearts, beware 🙏
e: Yashoda tackles a sensitive subject through disturbing imagery and an increasingly uneasy thriller setup. The interval and post-interval portions are deliberately uncomfortable, while Samantha leads a strong cast and Mani Sharma’s BGM keeps a constant sense that something is wrong beneath the surface.
body:
not sure what to write? The Story and Visuals are not for the sensitive hearted 🙏 and makes you feel discomfort especially the interval and post interval block….

Even now me and wife are trying to figure out whether it is the AC in the multiplex on a winter night (or) the unpleasant visuals which sent us shivers down the spine, where as my daughter was watching the movie more excitingly and even posing us questions on Surrogacy!!!

if you are in game of watching hard hitting movies with couple of unpleasant visuals then its a must watch film as it touched a very sensitive topic!!!!

Acting & Action wise Samantha was at her usual best and Unni Mukundan, Varalaxmi Sarathkumar got some meaty roles and they gave their best!!! Rao Ramesh & Murali Sharma did their routine bit without much effort!!!

BGM by Mani Sharma adds depth to the scenes and carries that feel if something is fishy throughout the first half!!!

The duo of Hari & Harish who are the both Writers and Directors of this movie did a good job, though the CG work could have been far better!!!!

v: Just VAAAAAVVVV!!! 🔥 Simple story, but the folklore + raw visuals + BGM + Rishab turn it into full JAATHAARAAA. Last 20 mins... madness 🙏
e: Kantara begins with a familiar landlord-versus-tribal conflict but becomes something far more immersive through folklore, raw staging, spectacular sound and Rishab Shetty’s complete creative commitment. The final twenty minutes are the kind of cinematic madness that make the theatre itself feel like part of the experience.
body:
Just Vaaaaavvvvv!!!!!! Simple age old story of Landlord vs Tribals….but the approach of involving folk-fare, the terrific Visuals, terrific BGM, terrific Performances, terrific Action sequences are what which make this movie a MASTER PIECE!!!!! your eyes and ears cannot distract from what is being served on the Big Screen…..If there is any movie in the recent past which cannot be missed on Big Screen, then this is THE ONE

Rishab Shetty take a bow man!!!! before going to the movie I have obviously gone through all the reviews going gaga on how he is the Writer Director and Main Lead of the movie….but after watching the movie personally I felt he had no other option from donning the hat of all 3, as it would be impossible for any other person to understand and believe what he has on paper and how it would translate on to big screen 🙏 and what he has done in the last 20 mins on screen is simply he only can understand what he wants to do….TERRIFIC!!!

The way the movie was handled in complete Raw and Rustic way, the way each character arch has been addressed will simply blow your minds….

All said and done…this movie is not for normal cini goer or for those who seek entertainment and not even for those who has concern with the basic story telling approach of this movie!!!! But for those who seek a different Visual and Audio experience on Big Screen….you are in for a JAATHAAARAAA!!!!!

For years or probably decades Kanada Movie Industry was at rock bottom with even other language films out performing their movies in their own territory….Upendra was partially their saving grace and that too only for a limited audience!!! But in recent past and special mention to Hombale Films for bringing back the glory to Kanada film industry 🙏🙏🙏

v: Style undi, fights unnayi, BGM kuda super... story మాత్రం below average 😪 Good craft keeps trying, but The Ghost never really pulls you in.
e: The Ghost has several technically strong ingredients — Praveen Sattaru’s direction, an interesting screenplay structure, well-edited fights and an effective BGM. Unfortunately, the routine and underwritten core story never creates enough involvement, leaving all that craft functioning mainly as a saving grace.
body:
Average!!! Good Direction, Interesting Screenplay, Good BGM, Excellently Choreographed & Edited Fights …. all gone in vain due to below average story!!!!

The content never gets you hooked to what’s happening on the screen….all the remaining factors are just saving grace to cover up the below par content!!!!

The title of the movie though powerful is a mismatch to the story and disappoints the audience who went to watch the movie after expectations from the title!!!

Praveen Sattaru couldn’t impress with the routine action format story this time, though his direction was good!!!

BGM was damn good and elevated the action parts….

Though age is catching up, Nagarjuna tried his best to fit in the role….acting wise there is nothing much in the role nor acting is expected much from him!!!!

v: Finally... MEGA BOSS IS BACK!!! 😍 Chiru’s eyes do enough mass work, Satyadev almost steals the show and Salman Bhai takes care of all physics violations 😂
e: GodFather worked for me as a strong Chiranjeevi comeback vehicle despite abandoning many of his usual commercial ingredients. The political-thriller setup lets his screen presence and expressions dominate, while Satyadev makes brilliant use of his biggest mainstream platform and repeatedly stands toe-to-toe with the film’s stars.
body:
After an Average Sye Raa and Debacle Aacharya….Finally MEGA BOSS is BACK!!!

Though there was little buzz around the movie as its a Remake (with original movie already being available in Telugu) and Acharaya being a Disaster….I looked forward eagerly for this movie for the only fact that Chriu had a terrific record with Remakes not only financially but also upgrading the overall film to next level (barring Shankar Dada Zindabad)

Content wise I haven’t watched the original Lucifer and hence cannot compare any aspect with that…

I felt that its a full meals for Mega fans though there are no trademark Mega commercial elements like Comedy or Regular Chiru trademark Songs or his ever charming steps ….but still Chiru’s God Father enthrals us!!!! Those expressive eyes are Chiru’s major asset and man this political thriller gives ample scope for those killer expressions 🙏

Satyadev is an asset for Telugu Industry, this was his first big platform to showcase his talent to general mass audience and he utilised it to the core….the way he stood out with his performance against the likes of Murali Sharma, Nayantara, Salman and Chiru is commendable!!! In few scenes he simply took the limelight away from Chiru with his terrific performance 🙏🙏🙏

Murali Sharma, Nayantara and others were apt in their roles…..

I felt the Direction and Writers team did a good job though majority of their work was already done!!! I never felt that I was watching a remake movie 🤔

Though Thaman’s BGM was good and gave good elevation to Mega Eyes!!! I felt he could have done way better especially after what he did in Akhanda!!!

now a days every commercial action/fights are being trolled for their over the top sequences unless its KGF….and here the Chiru and Director did excellently used Salman bhai for those episodes so that all the trolling would be on him 😉 😉 😉

Salman does what he knows the best….Physics ki KCPD chesi vadiladu!!! I seriously demand a movie by Boyapati mama with Salman Khan….idharu kalisi Phyiscs ni Bang Bang Bang chesestharu 🥸
